description: This file contains benchmarking code for the Mastra AI framework, measuring tool registration time, memory footprint, cold start, and invocation latency.

classes.name: BenchmarkResult
classes.description: Interface representing individual benchmark metrics with optional fields for iterations and tool count.

classes.name: BenchmarkSuite
classes.description: Interface representing a collection of benchmark results along with system info and raw data.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Interface for statistical summary including mean, standard deviation, min, max, and percentiles.

methods.name: calculateStats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (mean, stdDev, min, max, percentiles) from an array of numbers.

methods.name: getMemoryUsageMB
methods.description: Returns current heap memory usage in megabytes.

methods.name: benchmarkToolRegistration
methods.description: Benchmarks the registration time for a number of tools over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmarkMemory
methods.description: Benchmarks memory footprint during tool creation over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmarkColdStart
methods.description: Measures cold start time for creating a ping tool over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmarkToolInvocation
methods.description: Measures invocation latency for a set of tools over a number of invocations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the benchmarking process and outputting results.
